e11.scope: Fixed-default external-baseline probe on16 consulted families, same48 E10 training-pool heldout folds. No new original outer-test scoring; no tuned-SOTA superiority claim.
e11.prototype_references: Exact copied E10 geometric diagonal UU/GG, alpha.5, budgets25/50/75/100%; same48 fits/heldout/excluded sets

e12.scope: Prospectively frozen evaluation on one previously unscored PyLDL Ren_Cecps packaged variant; five disjoint fit/test feature-group allocations. Not broad independent cross-dataset confirmation.
e12.allocation: Unique full-feature vectors define exact-duplicate groups using np.unique(axis=0,return_inverse=True). Permute group IDs with seed202611150012; consume previously unused groups until enough rows for fit384, then test512, repeated5 times. Keep first required rows in original row order from each consumed block; omitted group members never used later. All10 allocations use disjoint groups. No labels used for allocation.
e12.group_limit: Only exact feature duplicate groups; document/blog/author IDs absent, so no document-/author-disjoint claim.
e12.primary_candidate: GG50, geometric hierarchy, NN5, alpha=.5, zeta=.5, Full; fixed before any Ren prediction. Cost40 is a prespecified secondary view.
e12.secondary_candidates: UU/GG at25/50/75/100% in each mask; no choosing best budget after scoring.
e12.source_caveat: Actual packaged data is32420x100 with8labels, whereas published DBC-LDL describes35096x100; upstream filtering difference not established. Do not call it the full original corpus.
e12.prior_use_audit: No Ren result records found in local paper artifacts; existing26dataset manifest excludes Ren, and only generic dataset-exclusion README mentions other unused files.

SABFGS.optimizer_diagnostics: passthrough wrapper records result, without changing arguments or outputs

RKNN_native.optimizer: upstream SGD1e-3 for model and rho
RKNN_native.early_stopping: none except fail model on nonfinite training loss
RKNN_native.native_query_kernel: Upstream estimates RBF gamma separately from each full query-versus-training distance batch; preserve and disclose query-batch dependence.

RKNN_train_gamma.training: Same fitted RKNN_native model, no second fit
RKNN_train_gamma.prediction: Explicit adapter fixes query RBF gamma to1/(2*mean(pairwise_euclidean(stored_training_X,stored_training_X))**2), using the exact upstream float32 training state, and the same train matrix for query kernel. Rest identical; not called unmodified upstream/original algorithm.

preprocessing.external: Training-only minmax per selected column, no clipping; constant-span columns mapped tozero. AA uses upstream Euclidean neighbors, SA upstream softmax linear model, RKNN above.
preprocessing.ours: Inherited Full calibration, beta1,zeta.5,k5, half training-mean shrinkage; fixed exact-budget hierarchy. Cost40 may use Full training calibration, so no full training-acquisition savings claim.
preprocessing.masks: E11 inherits E10 design. E12 costs integers1..10 seed202611150013, independent feature order seed202611150014; take cumulative prefix within40percent total and sort selected indices. No cost optimization on labels.

seed: External per method/mask: (202611150000+1000*family_index+100*fold+10*mask_index+method_index) modulo2**32; E12 family_index16. torch singleCPU thread, deterministic algorithms enabled, Keras backend torch.
freezing: All48 E11 and5 E12 prediction files and failures must be frozen before any new scoring; score command requires both frozen manifests. Already-consulted E10 references do not become new confirmation.

metrics.primary: Brier=sum_j(pred-target)^2 averaged overobjects, on returned arrays without renormalization
secondary: KL natural log withprediction floor1e-12 and0log0 convention
metrics.validation: Finite, nonnegative, mass error<=1e-5 forfloat32 upstream; own controls1e-12. Record maximum mass error, no silent normalization.
metrics.aggregation: Within family pool all heldout object losses; equalweight16 families for E11. Ren pool5x512 testobjects for one dataset, not5independent datasets.
metrics.comparisons: Primary GG50 versus each of fiveexternal prediction variants, bothmasks reported. Secondary all prespecifiedbudgets/UU. Negative Brier difference favorsGG. Ties1e-12. No bestpoint, confirmatorypvalue or SOTAclaim.

failure_policy: Keep all nonfinite/errors/warnings and optimizer termination diagnostics. No configuration repair or fallback under method name. Failure rows explicitly missing; report complete-family coverage for pairwise comparisons and all failures.
resources: Diagnostic walltimes only, not fair full-method resource comparisons; E11 prototype fits are reused, so do not compare their copied timing with freshly fitted baselines.
privacy: Public code/protocol/aggregate results/checksums only. Source matrices, row allocations, labels, per-object predictions and detailed logs stay in explicitly authorized private cache.
